tracks.title: Modelo y estructura
tracks.text: Learning English opens career opportunities. Furthermore, it allows you to communicate with people worldwide.
tracks.translation: Aprender inglés es mucho trabajo. Sin embargo, las recompensas son enormes.

tracks.title: Contraste guiado
tracks.text: He studied twelve hours a day for three months. As a result, he passed the IELTS with a band 8.
tracks.translation: Estudia cada mañana para estar lista para el IELTS.

tracks.title: Práctica en contexto
tracks.text: The test was very hard. However, most students managed to pass.
tracks.translation: A pesar de tener poco tiempo, logró mejorar su expresión oral.
